# Director action import acceptance fixture

`quaternius-walk-import.glb` contains the real `Walk_Loop` quaternion tracks from Quaternius Universal Animation Library Standard, licensed CC0 1.0. Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html. Original GLB SHA-256: `69591853d817488edaa8fd9bf8fc1d821eaeaf789f8627b3cd23b41c4ed67997`.

The fixture retains all 65 bone names/rest transforms and takes at most 20 evenly spaced original samples per rotation track. No synthetic motion is substituted. Mesh geometry is a disposable triangle needed to mark the skeleton in GLB. Import name: `Walk_Loop_CC0_Import`. File size 65,656 bytes. It is for functional import acceptance, not animation-quality comparison.
